subtitle: 看表格寫出學生最常用的上學方式
task: The table shows the results of a survey of 200 students at a high school (fictional data). It shows how they get to school every day. Describe the information in the table.
taskZh: 表格是一所高中 200 位學生的調查結果（虛構資料），顯示他們每天怎麼上學。請描述表格中的資訊。

chart.title: How 200 students at a high school get to school

en: The table shows how 200 students at a high school get to school every day.

The bus is the most popular way to get to school, with 70 students. The MRT comes second, with 50 students. Forty students walk to school, and 25 students ride a bicycle. Only 15 students go to school by car.
Overall, most students use public transportation. This may be because buses and the MRT are cheap and convenient. Very few students are driven to school by their parents.
zh: 這個表格顯示一所高中的 200 位學生每天怎麼上學。
公車是最受歡迎的上學方式，有 70 位學生。捷運排第二，有 50 位學生。有 40 位學生走路上學，25 位學生騎腳踏車。只有 15 位學生坐車上學。
整體來說，大部分學生搭乘大眾運輸。這可能是因為公車和捷運便宜又方便。很少有學生是由父母開車送去上學的。
